currentSemanticAudit.definition: Counts below cover all 1,279 parseable official sentence annotations. An operator is counted when it occurs anywhere in the official typed formula; exact means alpha-normalized typed-formula equality, not lexical overlap.

language.requiredMechanism: A typed scope parser must distinguish predicate coordination, noun-phrase coordination, shared subjects, and nested either/neither constructions without flattening them into one lexical predicate.
Clause boundary selection needs explicit subject sharing, relative-clause attachment, and quantifier scope. A lexical-overlap tie must remain ambiguous.

Binary argument attachment, pronoun and definite-description resolution, and predicates absent from the premise-declared vocabulary need typed evidence. The adapter must not invent a relation or select an equally ranked candidate.

closedLanguageGaps.mechanism: The generic parser enumerates possible relative/main-predication boundaries, shares the quantified variable across both clauses, and accepts only a unique typed formula; competing supported scopes remain AMBIGUOUS.
closedLanguageGaps.controls: Nonce predicates and constants survive full renaming, while exchanging relative and main predications changes the audited formula.

closedLanguageGaps.mechanism: Two resolved named terms may share one typed predication, while complete left and right clauses are parsed independently before Boolean composition.
closedLanguageGaps.controls: The two constructions retain different term assignments even when both have an outer conjunction.

closedLanguageGaps.mechanism: A uniquely resolved binary relation introduces a typed object binder constrained by its class; a later object pronoun reuses that binder in the consequent relation.
closedLanguageGaps.controls: Entity, class, relation, action, and object vocabulary are all replaced together; implication and biconditional surfaces remain meaning-changing contrasts.

closedExecutionGaps.mechanism: Tasks exceeding the exhaustive finite evaluator's small-atom threshold now fall through to generic query-directed Tseitin-CNF and DPLL with independently checked certificates or countermodels.
closedExecutionGaps.effect: The previous resource-limited official-formula and query-language cases are executed without dropping source rows or enlarging the exhaustive enumeration bound.

execution.interpretation: The bounded named-domain interpretation finds no satisfying assignment. It does not apply explosion or coerce the case to an official label.

freshEvidence.reason: The pinned official v0.0 source has no released test set, and both local labeled files are development-visible.
freshEvidence.consequence: The generic language module remains an adapter-guided research candidate and is not registered in the deployed Stage A parser.
